Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We're excited to get Redwood live for the Starlit customer success automation pilot. Per your request during the call, I'm attaching our DPA draft for you to review and I'm including a short security overview PDF.

Quick questions to unblock procurement on our side:

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Starlit onboarding — initial package and PO questions

Hi Erin — great to meet you (again) and thanks for sending the materials. Quick checklist from our side so we can move to PO issuance: 

1) DPA: We typically ask vendors to sign Redwood's standard DPA. I've attached a link to our DocuSign envelope in the related links; please confirm whether you'd like to sign our DPA or propose redlines to the draft you shared. If you propose redlines, please send them as a tracked .docx.

2) SOC 2: Procurement requires a current SOC 2 Type II report (or a shareable read-only link to the report on your secure portal). If the report is under NDA, we can accept access via a secure URL and a contact for the SOC2 reviewer.

3) Subprocessors: We need a current subprocessor list (CSV preferred). Please include hosting, analytics, and any third-party model providers if applicable.

4) Billing details: Legal entity name, remit-to address, tax ID (EIN), and preferred invoice email. We issue POs once the security package is validated. Standard terms are Net30 unless otherwise negotiated.

David (procurement) and Monica (legal ops) are copied to coordinate redlines and PO flow. David — can you confirm the PO template and whether we should request W-9 up front or after DPA sign?

Thanks — aiming to have procurement sign-off this week if we can get the SOC2 link and subprocessor list.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com | (510) 555-0142
From: David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Starlit onboarding — initial package and PO questions

Hi Erin — David from Redwood Procurement here. Thanks for sending the draft and overview. A few procurement-specific items to keep things moving: 

- SOC 2: Please provide a link to the most recent SOC 2 Type II report. If access requires credentials, send a contact for the reviewer and a short-term read-only link (we can accept a time-bound URL).
- Subprocessors: CSV is preferred. Please include vendor name, function, location (region), and whether they have access to customer data (yes/no).
- W-9: For US vendors we generally request a W-9 or equivalent tax form before PO issuance. If you prefer to send it after DPA signing, note that PO timing may be delayed by a day or two.
- Invoicing: We use Net30 by default. Please confirm your preferred invoice remittance email and whether you require electronic invoicing (supplier portal) or email PDFs.
- PO info we need to issue: legal entity name, billing address, remit-to instructions, and any required PO contact.

Monica — once we receive the SOC 2 link and subprocessor CSV I'll do the security intake. If DPA redlines are requested, please flag material changes (data residency, subprocessors, audit rights) so Legal can triage.

Erin — if you can provide the SOC2 link and subprocessor CSV today, we'll aim to issue the PO next business day.

Regards,
David Kim
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
david@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0180
